sentences.content: Mum and Dad are busy and tired. What can we do for them?

sentences.content: We can also make a gift!

sentences.chinese: 我们还可以准备一份礼物！

sentences.content: I have a happy family. We often cook together and ...

sentences.chinese: 我有一个幸福的家庭。我们经常一起做饭，而且...

sentences.content: I sweep the floor. It's easy.

sentences.chinese: 我们是一个幸福的家庭。

sentences.content: He can look after his sister.
